DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの書類を提出する前のご相談ですね。どちらへ提出されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice before submitting the documents you brought. Where will you submit them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先へ出します。家にあった証明書のコピーを持ってきましたが、これで足りるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務先用に古い証明書コピーが足りるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: To my employer. I brought a copy of a certificate I had at home, and I want to know whether it will be sufficient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether an old certificate copy is sufficient for your employer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先の指定を照らしてみましょう。コピーでもよいか、発行時期の条件があるか聞いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us compare it with the recipient's requirements. Have you asked whether a copy is acceptable and whether there are conditions on when it was issued?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: コピーのことは聞いていません。日付を見たらかなり前だったので、今の証明として使ってよいか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: コピー可否を聞いておらず古い発行日が気になると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not asked about copies. I noticed the date was quite old, so I am worried whether it can serve as current proof.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not asked whether copies are accepted and are concerned about the old issue date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 勤務先に必要な書類名と発行時期、原本の要否を確認しましょう。こちらでは指定がわかってから種類を相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ask your employer for the required document name, issue-date requirements and whether an original is necessary. Once we know the requirements, we can discuss which type you need here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ見た目だからと決めずに、勤務先へ聞きます。自分の分だけ必要か、部数についても確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類名と発行時期に加えて対象と部数を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask my employer instead of deciding just because it looks the same. I also want to check whether only my own document is needed and how many copies are required.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whose documents and how many copies are needed, as well as the document name and issue-date requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 部数も確認しておくとよいですね。指定に合う申請について、担当が持ち物などをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is a good idea to check the number of copies too. The staff in charge will explain what to bring and how to apply in accordance with the requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しいものを申請する場合の担当窓口を教えてください。今日は古いコピーを見せて、質問を整理する相談にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日の相談と新規申請を区別して窓口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please tell me which counter handles applications for a new one. Today I would like to show the old copy and get advice to organize my questions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish today's consultation from a new application and ask which counter to visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当先をご案内します。申請を済ませたわけではないので、指定がわかったら書類とメモを持ってご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will direct you to the staff in charge. You have not completed an application, so once you know the requirements, please bring the documents and your notes to discuss it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 勤務先に書類名と日付の条件、原本と部数を聞きます。確認後に担当へ相談し、古いコピーはそのまま提出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 勤務先の指定を確認してから申請を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask my employer about the document name, date requirements, original and number of copies. After checking, I will consult the staff and will not submit the old copy as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check your employer's requirements before discussing an application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 提出前に確認する点がそろいました。担当先の案内をお渡ししますね。今日のご相談、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have identified what you need to check before submission. I will give you directions to the staff in charge. Thank you for consulting us today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の記入について伺います。今、どの欄を確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: I would like to ask about filling out the medical questionnaire. Which field are you checking now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「既往歴」という欄です。今、鼻がつまっていることを書く場所なのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 既往歴に現在の鼻の症状を書くのか確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The field labelled medical history. Is that where I should write that my nose is blocked now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether your current nasal symptoms belong in the medical history field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この欄では、以前にかかった病気などを伺っています。今の症状は、別にお話しいただきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This field asks about illnesses you have had in the past. Please tell us about your current symptoms separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今のこととは別なのですね。鼻がつまって気になり始めたのは今朝で、以前の病気の名前はよく覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今朝の症状と以前の病名が不明だと分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is separate from my current condition. I first noticed the blocked nose this morning, and I do not clearly remember the names of my previous illnesses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain separately that the symptoms began this morning and that you do not know the names of past illnesses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 覚えていないことは、そのように伝えてください。以前の受診がわかる資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please say so if you do not remember something. Do you have any records of your previous medical visits?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 以前の書類は家にあります。病名を想像して書かず、書類で確認できるか担当に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家の書類を使う相談をし病名を推測で書かない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The old documents are at home. Instead of guessing an illness name, I would like to ask the staff whether I can check it using those documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about using documents at home and do not guess an illness name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ相談の内容を伝えます。今の鼻の症状について、ほかに伝えたい様子はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass your question to the staff. Is there anything else you want to tell us about your current nasal symptoms?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 左右のどちらかと聞かれても、自分でははっきり言えません。わからない点はそのまま伝えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 左右がはっきりしないまま説明できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if asked which side it is, I cannot say clearly myself. May I explain honestly what I do not know?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can explain that you are unsure which side is affected. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身でわかることと、わからないことを分けて説明してください。欄の記入も確認しながら進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please distinguish what you know yourself from what you do not know. Let us also check the fields as we fill them in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今朝から鼻がつまることと、左右ははっきりしないことを伝えます。以前の病気は資料の確認について相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在の開始時期と不明点と過去資料を別に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that my nose has been blocked since this morning and that I am unsure which side. For past illnesses, I will ask about checking the records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the onset and uncertainties of current symptoms separately from past records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今の症状と以前の情報を分けられましたね。記入を確認する担当へ引き継ぎます。問診票をお持ちのままお待ちください。ご説明ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have separated your current symptoms from past information. I will pass this to the staff checking the form. Please wait with your questionnaire. Thank you for explaining.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 電話の内容が気になってご相談に来られたのですね。どのようなお話でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You came because you were concerned about a phone call. What did the caller say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族だと言う人から、電話番号が変わったと連絡がありました。声がいつもと違った気がして、本人か確かめられていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族を名乗る新番号の連絡が本人か未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone claiming to be a family member said their phone number had changed. Their voice seemed different from usual, and I have not verified who they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not verified a caller claiming to be family and giving a new number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 覚えている発言を伺いましょう。電話した時刻や番号がわかる記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me what you remember them saying. Do you have a record showing the call time or number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 着信の記録があります。相手に言われた新しい番号もメモしましたが、元の番号とは別に書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 着信と伝えられた新番号を別々に提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the incoming-call record. I also noted the new number they gave me, but wrote it separately from the original number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the incoming-call record and the stated new number separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つを分けて確認しましょう。ほかに頼まれたことや、ご自身が伝えたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the two separately. Did they ask for anything else, or did you tell them anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 後で連絡すると言われ、私は家にいると答えました。お金の話はまだ出ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 後で連絡するという発言と在宅の返答を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They said they would contact me later, and I replied that I was at home. Money has not come up yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that they said they would call later and that you replied you were at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今お話しいただいた範囲で記録します。家族本人への確認は、どのような状況ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record what you have told me so far. How far have you got in checking with the actual family member?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 以前から知っている連絡先へ電話しましたが、まだ返事がありません。相手が本人だとも偽物だとも決めずに相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 既知の連絡先へ電話したが返事がないと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I called a contact number I already knew, but have not had a response yet. I want advice without deciding that the caller is either genuine or an impostor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you called a known contact number but have not received a reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が取れていない状況として担当へつなぎます。新しい連絡があれば、受けた内容と時刻も記録しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will refer you to the staff with the identity still unverified. If there is further contact, please record what was said and when it was received too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 着信の記録と番号のメモ、自分が答えたことを見せます。本人からの返事や追加の電話があれば、担当に内容を知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録と返答を見せ本人や相手からの連絡を担当へ知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the call record, my number notes and what I answered. If the family member replies or there is another call, I will tell the staff what was said.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the records and your responses, and inform the staff of contact from your family member or the caller. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 伝えていただいた情報を整理して引き継ぎます。担当の案内を確認しますので、記録をお手元に置いてお待ちください。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will organize the information you provided and pass it on. Please keep the records with you and wait while I check the staff's guidance. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の内容を確認します。箱には何が入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me check the contents of your parcel. What is in the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 親戚へ渡す贈り物です。小さい玩具なので、この箱のまま送れるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 贈り物の小さい玩具をその箱で送れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a gift for a relative. It is a small toy, and I want to ask whether I can send it in this box as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can send the small toy gift in that box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 贈り物という用途だけでなく、物の種類も教えてください。電池が入っている物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the type of item, as well as its purpose as a gift. Does it contain batteries?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電池で動く玩具です。電池を入れたままですが、種類は覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電池入りだが種類を覚えていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is a battery-operated toy. The batteries are still inside, but I do not remember their type.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that batteries are inside but you do not remember their type. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 種類や状態がわかる情報を確認してから、発送条件を調べましょう。説明書や製品の表示はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check information about the battery type and condition before looking up the shipping requirements. Do you have the instruction manual or product markings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 説明書は家にあります。普通の玩具だから送れると思わず、電池の種類も調べて持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明書と電池種類を調べてから相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The manual is at home. I will not assume an ordinary toy can be sent; I will check the battery type and bring the information too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the manual and battery type before asking for advice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当がその情報と梱包の状態を確認します。今は受付が済んだわけではないので、発送日はまだ決めないでおきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will check that information and how it is packed. Your parcel has not been accepted yet, so let us leave the shipping date undecided for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手には確認中だと伝えます。説明書を読んでも種類がわからなければ、その不明点も相談してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手に確認中と知らせ不明点も相談できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell the recipient that I am checking. If I still cannot identify the type after reading the manual, may I ask about that uncertainty too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell the recipient you are checking and ask whether you may discuss unclear points too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、わからない部分をそのまま示してください。担当の確認後に、送れる方法や準備があるかをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please show us exactly which parts you do not understand. After the staff check, we will explain whether there is a shipping method available or any preparation needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 贈り物ではなく電池で動く玩具だと具体的に伝えます。説明書でわかる情報と不明点を持参し、条件がわかってから発送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 具体的な玩具と電池情報を示し条件確認後に送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will specify that it is a battery-operated toy instead of just calling it a gift. I will bring the information and uncertainties from the manual and send it after learning the requirements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify the toy and battery information and send it after checking the requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 内容を詳しく伺えてよかったです。説明書と荷物をそろえて再度ご相談ください。それでは、準備ができた際にお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am glad we could clarify the contents. Please come back with the manual and parcel together. We look forward to seeing you when you are ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 教材代のお振込みですね。案内の振込先と金額を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to transfer payment for study materials. Let us check the recipient and amount in the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらの口座へ、この本体額を振り込めばよいと思っています。案内には送料の欄もあるので、少し迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本体額と送料欄のある教材代を振込み前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I think I should transfer this base amount to this account. But the instructions also have a shipping-charge field, so I am a little unsure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask before transferring payment for study materials with a base amount and shipping-charge field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 請求書の金額を、ご自身が払う総額と照らしましょう。本体額だけなのかは送付元にも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Compare the invoice amount with the total you need to pay. Please also ask the sender whether only the base amount is payable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 送料を含めた合計の欄がありました。この合計が支払う額か、教材の担当に確認してから進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送料込みの請求総額を教材の担当へ聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I found a total including shipping. I would like to check with the person responsible for the materials whether that total is the amount payable before proceeding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the staff responsible for study materials about the invoice total including shipping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 請求内容が確かめられてから振込みを相談しましょう。振込先の名義なども、案内と一致するか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us discuss the transfer once the invoice details are confirmed. Please also check that the account holder's name and other recipient details match the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 振込先は案内と照らします。送料を含む額に、さらに銀行の振込費用が入るのかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 振込先を照らし銀行の費用が別か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will compare the recipient with the instructions. I also want to know whether the amount including shipping includes the bank transfer fee as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare the recipient details and ask whether the bank fee is separate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 教材側へ支払う金額と、振込みにかかる費用を分けてご案内します。費用は利用する方法などを確認してからになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain the amount payable to the materials provider separately from the transfer fee. We can explain the fee after checking the transfer method and other details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 請求の合計と銀行の費用を別のメモにします。手続き前に両方を確認して、支払う総額を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 請求額と銀行費用を分け実行前の総額を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will note the invoice total and bank fee separately. I want to check both before the transaction and know the total amount I will pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate the invoiced amount and bank fee and ask for the total before execution. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 金額と宛先を確かめてから進めましょう。確認だけで振込みが実行されたとは考えず、完了の内容も最後に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us proceed after checking the amount and recipient. Do not assume checking alone has executed the transfer; confirm the completion details at the end too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 教材側に請求総額を聞き、振込先と銀行の費用を別に確かめます。情報がそろってから進め、実行の完了も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 請求総額と宛先と費用を確かめ完了も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask the materials provider for the invoice total and separately check the recipient and bank fee. Once I have all the information, I will proceed and confirm completion too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the invoice total, recipient and fee, and confirm completion as well. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 相談する金額を分けられましたね。請求内容の確認後に案内をお持ちください。引き続き窓口でご相談を承ります。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have separated the amounts to ask about. Please bring the instructions after confirming the invoice details. We will continue to assist you at the counter. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計を始める前に、ご希望がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any requests before we start checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事で使う物と自分の物を一緒にかごへ入れました。レシートを分けたいので、別々に会計できるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事用と私用のレシートを分けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put work items and personal items in the same basket. I want separate receipts, so I would like to ask whether I can pay for them separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether receipts can be separated for work and personal purchases. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 方法を確認します。どちらの商品が仕事用か、会計前に分けていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check how we can do that. Could you separate the work items before checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらの文房具が仕事用で、食品は私用です。かごの左右に分けましたが、指で示してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 文房具と食品をかごで分けて指し示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This stationery is for work, and the food is personal. I separated them on the two sides of the basket; may I point them out too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate the stationery and food in the basket and point them out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 指して確認しましょう。袋もそれぞれ分けるご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check by pointing. Would you also like separate bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 仕事用には持参した袋を使います。食品用の袋を購入する場合、私用の会計に入れられるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仕事用の持参袋と食品側への袋代を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will use a bag I brought for the work items. If I buy a bag for the food, I want to know whether its cost can go on the personal transaction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you brought a work bag and want the food bag charged with personal purchases. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋の条件と会計への入れ方を確認します。お支払いの方法についても、ご希望を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the bag conditions and how to include the charge. Could you also tell me your preferred payment methods?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事用はカード、私用は現金を希望します。分けられるか確認してから、一つずつ支払いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カードと現金の別払いが可能か確かめて順に払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to pay by card for work and cash for personal items. After checking whether that is possible, I want to pay one transaction at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether separate card and cash payments are possible, then pay in sequence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望の方法が使えるか確かめます。それぞれの金額と商品を確認し、ひとつの会計が済んでから次を進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check whether those methods are available. Let us check the items and amount for each transaction and finish one before starting the next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 文房具と食品を分け、袋は食品側で相談します。使える方法を聞き、各会計の完了とレシートを順に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品と袋と方法を分け各完了とレシートを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will separate the stationery and food and ask about the bag with the food purchase. I will ask which payment methods work and check completion and the receipt for each transaction in order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate items, bags and methods and check each transaction's completion and receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 順番をそろえてから会計しますね。まず仕事用の商品をこちらで確認します。ご希望を先にお伝えいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will establish the order before checking out. First, let us check the work items here. Thank you for telling us your wishes beforehand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お二人で散歩のコースをご覧になっていますね。歩く範囲のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are both looking at the walking routes. Would you like advice about how far to walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人は長いコースを速く歩きたいそうですが、私は合わせると疲れます。私は別の短い道を選べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人に合わせると疲れるため別の短い経路を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend wants to walk the long route quickly, but I get tired if I keep up. Can I choose a different, shorter path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a separate shorter route because keeping up with your friend tires you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身に合う範囲を図で確認しましょう。途中で休む場所と、再び会う場所も考えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check a suitable distance for you on the map. Have you also considered places to rest along the way and where to meet again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 途中で座れる場所を知りたいです。友人とは入口近くでまた会う案を話したいので、その場所も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 座れる場所と入口近くの集合候補を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to know where I can sit along the way. I would like to suggest meeting my friend again near the entrance, so I want to check that location too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about seats and a possible meeting place near the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口近くの目印と休憩場所を照らしましょう。実際に使えるかは現地の表示も見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us compare landmarks near the entrance with rest areas. Please check the signs on site too to see whether they are actually available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 目印の名前を友人に伝えます。友人を探して長い道へ進まず、短い道から戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目印を伝え短い道から集合へ戻ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will tell my friend the landmark's name. I want to return by the short path instead of continuing along the long route to look for my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Name the landmark and explain that you will return to meet using the short path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 戻る候補も図で確認します。友人との集合は、場所だけでなく時間も双方で相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check possible return routes on the map too. Please agree on a meeting time with your friend, as well as a place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 歩く前に集合場所と時間を決めます。休憩で遅れる場合には連絡し、無理に友人の速さへ合わせません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 場所と時間を相談し休憩で遅れたら知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will decide the meeting place and time before walking. I will let my friend know if resting makes me late, and I will not force myself to match their speed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Agree on a place and time and notify your friend if resting delays you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別々に歩く予定を友人へ伝えておきましょう。集合場所へ早く着いた場合も、通路を空けて休める所を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let your friend know you plan to walk separately. Please also check somewhere you can rest without blocking the path if you reach the meeting place early.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 短い道と休憩場所から集合場所へ戻る案にします。友人と時間を決め、遅れるときは連絡して自分の速さで歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 短い道で休憩し友人と決めた場所へ自分の速さで戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: My plan is to return to the meeting place using the short path and rest areas. I will agree on a time with my friend, notify them if I am late and walk at my own pace.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Rest along the short route and return at your own pace to the place agreed with your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お互いの予定を確認してから出発してくださいね。休憩も含めて楽しめるといいですね。それでは、よい散歩を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40217-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check each other's plans before setting off. I hope you enjoy the walk, including your rests. Have a lovely walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遅れの案内をご覧になりましたか。待つ間の予定で、確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you seen the delay notice? Is there anything you would like to check about your plans while waiting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族に駅まで迎えを頼んでいます。遅れを伝えたいのですが、携帯電話の電池が少なくて何度も連絡できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 迎えを頼んだ家族へ遅れを知らせたいが携帯の電池が少ないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I asked my family to pick me up at the station. I want to tell them about the delay, but my phone battery is low and I cannot contact them repeatedly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to tell the family picking you up about the delay but your phone battery is low. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用案内では到着の見込みはまだ確定していません。家族へ何を先に伝えるか考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This practice notice does not yet give a confirmed expected arrival time. Let us think about what to tell your family first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 遅れが出ていて時刻は未確定だと一度伝えます。到着まで駅前で待ち続けなくてよいことも相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 遅延と未確定の時刻を伝え家族に駅前で待ち続ける必要があるか相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will tell them once that there is a delay and the time is unconfirmed. I also want to discuss whether they can avoid waiting outside the station the whole time until I arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will report the delay and uncertain time and discuss whether your family need to keep waiting outside the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 迎えを再度頼む時点も、家族の方と決めておけるとよいですね。ここでは画面以外に案内放送でも状況をお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would help to agree with your family when to ask for pickup again. Here, we provide updates through announcements as well as the screens.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 放送を聞ける所で待ちます。電池が切れた場合に備えて、家族の電話番号を紙に書いておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 放送を聞ける場所で待ち家族の番号を紙へ控えると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait where I can hear the announcements. I would like to write my family's phone number on paper in case the battery runs out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait within hearing range of announcements and write the family number on paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紙に控えておく案ですね。待つ場所を移る前に、放送が聞こえる範囲と現地の表示を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: So you plan to note it on paper. Before moving to another waiting place, check the signs and where you can hear the announcements on site.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 移る前に確かめます。放送の一部を聞き逃したら、聞いた所だけで判断せず窓口で確認してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 移動前に表示を見て聞いた一部だけで判断せず窓口で確認できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check before moving. If I miss part of an announcement, may I check at the counter rather than deciding based only on the part I heard?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the signs before moving and ask whether you may verify at the counter instead of judging from a partial announcement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 聞き逃した内容は窓口でお尋ねください。使う便の名前を言うと、どの案内かを確認しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask at the counter about anything you missed. Giving the name of your service makes it easier to identify the relevant announcement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族と次に連絡する時点を決め、番号を紙に控えます。放送が不明なら便の名前を伝えて聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次の連絡時点と番号を用意し不明な放送は便名で聞き直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will agree with my family when to contact them next and write the number on paper. If an announcement is unclear, I will give the service name and ask again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will arrange the next contact time, keep the number and ask again using the service name if an announcement is unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、待つ間の案内を確認しながらお過ごしください。ご出発の際は、ご家族への連絡も確かめてお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep checking the updates while you wait. When you set off, check your contact with your family too and travel safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の申込み後に届いたメールについてですね。どの部分が気になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a question about an email received after applying for a consultation. Which part concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申込みを受け付けましたとありますが、相談日時が見当たりません。もう一度申し込んだ方がよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受付の返事はあるが日時がなく再申込みすべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says my application was received, but I cannot find a consultation date or time. Should I apply again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to reapply because you have an acknowledgement but no date or time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用メールを読みましょう。下の段に、日時の案内を別に送ると書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us read this practice email. The lower section says the date and time will be sent separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受付の返事と日時の案内は別なのですね。同じ内容を二回送らず、次の案内を待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日時は別案内と理解し同内容を重送せず待ちたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the acknowledgement and scheduling notice are separate. I would like to wait for the next notice without sending the same application twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you understand the schedule comes separately and want to wait without duplicate submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 申込みが確定したとはまだ決めず、問い合わせるための情報も整理しましょう。受付番号は見つかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not assume the application is confirmed yet; let us also organize the information needed for an enquiry. Can you find the reference number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号は末尾にあります。控えておきますが、いつ問い合わせればよいかの説明はどこで確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付番号を控えいつ問い合わせるかの説明箇所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The number is at the end. I will note it, but where can I find an explanation of when I should enquire?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Note the reference number and ask where the enquiry-timing instructions are. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この練習用メールの問い合わせ欄を一緒に見ましょう。書かれていない条件は担当へ尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us look at the enquiry section in this practice email together. We will ask the staff about conditions not stated there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 問い合わせ欄を見ます。予定が変わったので、最初に出した希望日を直す方法も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 問い合わせ欄を見て予定変更による希望日の直し方を聞きたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will read the enquiry section. My plans have changed, so I also want to ask how to change the preferred date I originally submitted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will read the enquiry section and want to ask how to amend your preferred date after a change of plans. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しく同じ申込みを出すより、受付番号を伝えて変更の相談をする案です。変更できるかは担当の返事を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Rather than submitting the same application again, you can give the reference number and ask about a change. Please check the staff's reply to see whether a change is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付番号を伝え、希望日の変更と次の案内について問い合わせます。まだ日時確定とは思わず、二重に申し込みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付番号で変更と次の案内を問い合わせ確定扱いも重複申込みもしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give the reference number and enquire about changing my preferred date and the next notice. I will not assume the date and time are confirmed or submit a duplicate application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will enquire about the change and next notice using the reference number, without treating it as confirmed or reapplying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、問い合わせ欄と受付番号をお持ちください。担当の返事を確認してから、相談の日程を整えてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please have the enquiry section and reference number ready. After checking the staff's reply, arrange the consultation schedule.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計の書類をかばんへ入れる前に、確認したい点はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to check before putting your payment documents in your bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場へ見せる予定ですが、名前の一文字が違うように見えます。印字がつぶれているだけか、確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場へ見せる書類の一文字が異なるようで印字の問題か確認したいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I plan to show them at work, but one character in my name looks different. Could you check whether the printing is simply blurred?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that a character in a document for work looks different and you want to check whether the printing is the issue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 読みにくい文字を、どの行か示していただけますか。ここで間違いと決めず、登録と書類を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me which line contains the unclear character? Rather than deciding it is wrong here, we will ask the staff to check the registration and documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上の名前の二文字目です。私の名前を書いた紙もあるので、比べていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 上の名前の二文字目を指し本人名を書いた紙と比べてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is the second character in the name at the top. I also have a paper with my name written on it and would like you to compare them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to the second character in the name at the top and ask for comparison with your written name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その紙は確認用として見せてください。変更が必要か、出し直すかは担当が確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show that paper for checking. The staff will check before explaining whether a correction or reissue is necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認前に職場へ渡さず待ちます。手元のほかの書類にも同じ名前があるので、一緒に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認前に職場へ渡さず他書類の同名部分も見てもらいたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait and not give it to work before checking. My other documents here have the same name; could you look at them together too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the name on other documents to be checked too and do not hand them to work beforehand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類を混ぜずに並べてください。こちらで各書類の表示を確認する担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please lay the documents out without mixing them up. I will refer you to the staff who check the text on each document.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三枚を順に並べます。書類の種類まで取り違えないよう、表題を読んでどれが気になるか伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三枚を順に置き表題を読んで気になる種類を特定すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will arrange the three sheets in order. To avoid confusing the document types too, I will read their titles and explain which one concerns me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will arrange the three sheets, read the titles and identify the document type that concerns you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表題と該当箇所を示すと確認しやすいですね。返事が出るまで、書類にご自身で文字を直さずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Showing the title and relevant area will make checking easier. Please wait for a reply without correcting the characters on the documents yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分で書き直さず、名前の紙と三枚の表題を示します。確認が済んだ書類だけ職場に見せる準備をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 書き直さず本人名と表題を示し確認済み書類で提出準備をすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not rewrite them myself; I will show the paper with my name and the titles of the three sheets. I will prepare only documents that have been checked to show at work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will show your name and the titles without rewriting anything and prepare checked documents for submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、書類の確認が終わりましたらお呼びします。お持ち帰り前に表示を読み合わせて、どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40218-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will call you when the document check is complete. Before taking them home, let us read the text together. Have a safe journey home.
